turn_1.decision_relevance: Directly tests the customer promotion gate and can block promotion if any tenant class exceeds the p99 limit.
turn_1.expected_observation: Held-out p99 measurements by tenant class will reveal whether every class is below 250 ms; the mean improvement alone provides weak evidence, so I predict a 35% probability that all classes satisfy the objective.

turn_2.lesson: Aggregate mean latency can hide a tenant-specific tail regression; customer fitness requires checking p99 for every tenant class, and enterprise non-inferiority failed.
